scheme.client: client_cases: the client's checks of a prepare response before it shows the owner anything; error is the local refusal code, or null when it may sign
scheme.delivery: delivery_cases: a delivery body against the app's own row (null when it has none); verifier_code is the owner-act/1 refusal behind a 403, or null when the act verifies; result is the HTTP status, detail and response
scheme.manifest: manifest_cases: a version 3 manifest's owner_acts with the tools it names; error is the manifest refusal code, or null when it is valid
scheme.prepare: prepare_cases: the app's reading of a prepare body against the declared role; error is the 400 detail, or null when it records or reads a row
scheme.registry: delivery_cases' verifier.registry says whether stage 2 can read the team key; the forged_signature cases pair a present and an absent row under each, and the pair's results are equal
scheme.role_token: the declared role name (a leading letter, at most 23 bytes), a dot, and 32 to 40 lowercase hex characters; token_cases pin the bound against the owner-act/1 signer
scheme.signing: standard base64 with padding of the owner-act/1 signing bytes
